item.title: Soulslike 'Fountains' Gets A Free Switch 2 Upgrade Pack One Week After Launch

description.p: 120fps + an exclusive "Gauntlet Mode".We're into the final week of September and the video games have been coming so thick and fast that it's hard to keep up. One such game — indie Soulslike Fountains — released just last week on 17th September, although perhaps missing out on day one wasn't such a bad thing in this case: a free Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack has appeared on the eShop which adds 120fps support. Larvely.With a top-down view and a pixel-art aesthetic reminiscent of Hyper Light Drifter, Fountains is the work of Canada-based solo dev John Pywell, who started development back in 2020 before a successful Kickstarter campaign in 2022.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Book Review: Aliens: The Video Games - A Detailed Dive Into Xeno Adaptations

description.p: I admire its purity.It’s easy to forget just how many Aliens games have been made over the years. You’d be forgiven for wondering whether there are actually enough to warrant an entire book, but at 176 pages, Mike Diver’s Aliens: The Video Games covers just about everything, from an unlicensed 1981 Commodore PET title right up to the anticipated release of Alien: Isolation 2. Yes, Fireteam Elite 2 is missing, but it was announced long after the book’s completion. You can’t have everything.Much like Perfect Organism from Andy Kelly (who provides the foreword for this one), Diver's authority and high regard for the franchise is clear. His knowledge of the games shines on every page, and he demonstrates a keen eye for research, with relevant quotes from developers to add welcome texture.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Rumour: Zelda Movie Rumblings Suggest A First Trailer Might Be Around The Corner

description.p: Or is it just wishful thinking?Remember that slightly strange Zelda movie mention in the series' recent 40th Anniversary Direct, where Miyamoto confirmed the shocking news that the film will be titled... 'The Legend of Zelda'? We were all expecting something more, right? Some kind of teaser or perhaps a full-blown trailer? Well, the rumour mill has been a-turning in the weeks since, and a closer look might be just around the corner.It all started with movie star Bo Bragason, who shared a post on her Instagram story earlier this week with the caption "I'm excited 4 tomorrow". People quickly leapt to their own conclusions, expecting a trailer to drop in the ensuing 24 hours, though, obviously, one never materialised.
